title: VPN login timeout (India)
content:
# VPN login timeout (India)

## Check first
Check authentication provider latency and the token validation timeout settings. The expected token validation timeout is 10 seconds.

## Escalate
If identity provider latency is above 2 seconds, page the identity team. Do not restart the VPN gateway while logins are failing, because that drops active sessions.

## Recent changes
Ask the platform team whether an identity provider or VPN configuration change was deployed in the last hour.

title: VPN login timeout (India) - old
content:
# VPN login timeout (India), version 2

Restart the VPN gateway whenever users report login timeouts.

title: VPN login timeout (US)
content:
# VPN login timeout (US)

Fail over to the secondary identity provider in us-east before investigating clients. Then confirm the VPN client version is 7.3 or newer.

title: Payments database connection failure
content:
# Payments database connection failure

## Check first
Check the connection count on the primary against max_connections. Look for connection leaks introduced by a recent deploy.

## Mitigate
Roll back the suspect deploy, terminate idle sessions, then raise the pool limit only if the leak is ruled out.

title: Notification delivery delays
content:
# Notification delivery delays

When Slack returns 429, honour the Retry-After header and use exponential backoff with jitter. Never retry all clients at the same instant.
